name: Shelby County, KY
findings: Shelby County has 138 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Shelby County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Shelby County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 9 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
